sourceRefs.locator: Patron, date of construction AH 649 as stated in the 1253 foundation deed, and description of the tiled court, pool, dome and gates.
Müze Hakkında, Karatay’s patronage and studies of hadith and Quranic commentary. Yol Tarifi gives the museum location.
The Cambridge History of Turkey, chapter 3. The Seljuks of Rum and Mongol power after Kösedağ.

note.de: Die Stiftungsurkunde nennt 649 der Hidschra als Baujahr der Medrese. Im erhaltenen Bau zeigen Kuppel, Wasserbecken und mosaizierte Fliesen, wie der Unterrichtsort eingerichtet war.
note.en: The endowment deed dates the madrasa’s construction to AH 649. Its dome, pool and mosaic tiles preserve the arrangement of the place of learning.
